en: The postcard consists of two sides: the front shows a black-and-white photograph of a steamboat navigating a river, with forested banks and log-driving structures, labeled 'Liden i Sillre forsen'. The reverse side displays handwritten Swedish text, address lines, a green Swedish postage stamp, and printed words including 'Sundsvall–Indalsälfven 19.' and 'Foto. & förlag: Max Sellmann, Mariedal.'
